name: recruiting-help
description: Low-cost internship and co-op opportunity aggregator

scripts.check: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm test:integration
scripts.prod:backup: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f infra/compose.prod.yaml --profile backup run --rm backup
scripts.n8n:export: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.dev.yaml exec -T n8n n8n export:workflow --all --pretty
scripts.n8n:import: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.dev.yaml exec -T n8n n8n import:workflow --separate --input=/repo-workflows
scripts.n8n:publish:wf01: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.dev.yaml exec -T n8n n8n publish:workflow --id=Wf01GithubPoll00000001 && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.dev.yaml restart n8n
scripts.n8n:unpublish:wf01: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.dev.yaml exec -T n8n n8n unpublish:workflow --id=Wf01GithubPoll00000001 && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.dev.yaml restart n8n
